title: Anna at the Doctor
text:
Anna is not well today. She has a headache and her back hurts. She stays in bed and reads a book. Her mother gives her water.

At noon, Anna goes to the doctor. The doctor checks her ears and her throat. He says she has a small infection. He gives her medicine and says she must rest for two days.

questions.text: Why does Anna stay in bed?
What will probably happen to Anna in a few days?
options: She will go to the hospital forever

vocabulary.definition: a person who treats sick people
something you take to help you get better when you are ill
to relax and stop doing hard work so your body can recover

paragraph_translations: Anna dzisiaj nie czuje się dobrze. Boli ją głowa i plecy. Zostaje w łóżku i czyta książkę. Mama daje jej wodę.
W południe Anna idzie do lekarza. Lekarz sprawdza jej uszy i gardło. Mówi, że ma małe zakażenie. Daje jej lekarstwo i mówi, że musi odpoczywać przez dwa dni.
